nodes.label: Stack Decisions
nodes.rationale: SvelteKit 2 (Svelte 5 runes), SSR via adapter-cloudflare static assets + Worker, D1 unchanged, Tailwind v4, lucide-svelte, zod, CSS bars, runes stores, hand-rolled SW.

nodes.label: Environment Bindings (DB, ASSETS, secrets)
nodes.rationale: D1 binding DB (transactions, sessions, rate limits), ASSETS binding (PWA shell), SESSION_SECRET (HMAC), GOOGLE_API_KEY (optional Gemini), AI_BASE_URL and AI_MODEL vars.

nodes.label: Custom CSS Bars (no chart lib)
nodes.rationale: Old app has no chart library; analytics used CSS bars - keep that. SQL GROUP BY aggregates, CSS bars client-side.

nodes.label: D1 Database (unchanged)
nodes.rationale: Same database, same schema.sql; all existing data works with no migration. Password hashing format identical so existing master password keeps working.

nodes.label: Form Actions + Load Functions Pattern
nodes.rationale: Pages + API in one project; official Cloudflare adapter; form actions and load functions eliminate client-side fetch/state boilerplate. No client-api.ts, invalidateAll() refreshes after mutations.

nodes.label: Hand-rolled Minimal Service Worker
nodes.rationale: About 30 lines, no Workbox; cache-first static assets, network-only data; installable + offline shell. Data requires connectivity (same as old app).

nodes.label: Cloudflare Workers over Pages
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare's primary platform going forward; Pages is in maintenance mode; D1 binding and env vars live in config, not dashboard clicks.

nodes.label: Rupiah Currency Symbol
nodes.rationale: Indonesian Rupiah abbreviation rendered as the icon glyph; signals the app's Indonesian locale and currency.

nodes.label: Finance Tracker v2 (Project)
nodes.rationale: Personal finance tracker: transactions CRUD, monthly dashboard, analytics, AI copilot. SvelteKit rewrite of original Next.js app, single Cloudflare Worker with D1, OCR dropped.

nodes.label: App Icon (Rp on sky-blue)
nodes.rationale: 512x512 rounded square (rx 96), sky-blue #0ea5e9 fill matching app theme-color, bold white 'Rp' glyph centered.

nodes.label: Auth Flow (hooks guard, setup/login, rate limit)
nodes.norm_label: auth flow (hooks guard, setup/login, rate limit)
nodes.rationale: hooks.server.ts guard: /api/* gets 401 JSON never redirect, everything else redirects /login; setup vs login modes; D1 rate_limits table survives isolate restarts; CSRF via SvelteKit form action built-ins plus manual Origin check on JSON endpoints.

nodes.label: Next.js Finance Tracker (predecessor)
nodes.rationale: Next.js 15 + React 19 app this design replaces; source of ported auth.ts logic, globals.css, Navigation, Toast, ConfirmModal components.

nodes.label: Dark/Light Theme Persistence
nodes.rationale: CSS class toggle, preference in localStorage, defaults to system via prefers-color-scheme; port ThemeToggle component from React.

nodes.label: SvelteKit Rewrite Design
nodes.rationale: Approved design: lighter stack, fewer abstractions, idiomatic framework patterns, feature parity with old app minus OCR.

nodes.label: AI JSON Endpoints (parse + report)
nodes.rationale: AI parse stays JSON because results need interactive preview/confirmation before saving; report goes Gemini + D1 data. Origin header check replaces csrf.ts.

nodes.label: OCR Receipt Scanning Dropped
nodes.rationale: Non-goal by explicit user decision; Tesseract.js dependency removed entirely.
